business_problem: Accor's marketing organization needed finer customer segmentation and faster campaign execution across a complex global brand portfolio, but its previous tooling could not deliver the personalization or turnaround speed the business wanted.
solution_summary: Accor built a composable customer data platform on Snowflake with Hightouch to speed segmentation and campaign execution across its hospitality portfolio. Because Snowflake had already been the group's technical data platform since 2019, the team reused existing data models, ran a proof of concept around identifying guests likely to prefer luxury hotels, and put the new CDP into production only two months after initial tests. Snowflake now centralizes customer and prospect data across more than 45 brands, while Hightouch activates those audiences for marketers who can self-serve segments in days instead of waiting three weeks for the data team. The platform is also being extended with new attributes, third-party data, and connectors so regional and brand teams can work from a shared contact view while personalizing journeys, optimizing budget, and preparing AI-generated indicators such as brand affinity and commercial pressure scores.

solution_components.name: Snowflake
solution_components.role: Centralizes Accor's customer and prospect data and reuses existing enterprise data models for CDP activation.

solution_components.name: Hightouch
solution_components.role: Implements the composable CDP layer that turns Snowflake data into self-service segments and campaign-ready audiences.

data_flow: Customer and prospect data from Accor's global marketing organization is centralized in Snowflake, where existing data models and new attributes are refined into campaign segments. Hightouch then activates those segments so marketers can self-serve targeted campaigns and progressively enrich the shared global contact view with new connectors and third-party data.
business_outcome: Accor launched its CDP in two months, cut data turnaround for targeted campaigns from three weeks to a few days, improved marketing-budget efficiency, and gave more than 45 brands a shared foundation for personalized guest experiences and future AI-driven segmentation.
